top_signals.title: Gold Steady as Rate-Hike Bets Ease, Oil Pushes Yields Higher
top_signals.summary: Gold was little changed as traders weighed easing bets on an imminent Federal Reserve rate hike against a surge in oil prices that pushed Treasury yields higher.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.

top_signals.title: Dollar Has Worst Week in Month With Warsh Quiet on Rate Path
top_signals.summary: The dollar’s monthlong rally ran out of steam this week after remarks from Federal Reserve Chairman Kevin Warsh failed to give the currency a lift.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.
